purpose: Which problem the acceptance driver adjudicates, and which campaign node the run it writes belongs to. The driver code carries mechanics only: the primary problem id, the node id and the mission number are governance/domain vocabulary and live here, so re-pointing the acceptance run at another problem family is a config edit rather than a source change.
primary_problem_note: the only problem in this wave whose arms each report the total-resistance coefficient, so the adjudication criterion has at least three comparable arms; changing it requires a problem with the same property

reproducibility.note: C7 re-harvests the sources inside the same run and compares content_digest (wall-clock-free) rather than corpus_digest (byte identity), because the corpus embeds harvested_utc and its byte digest necessarily moves between runs
